newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins dip on U.S. data in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins dip on U.S. data in thin trade.

text.p: MinFin bonds edged down in thin, cautious trading on Friday before a long weekend in Russia.
U.S. February non-farm payrolls rose 339,000 after January's 271,000 gain, but most Russian banks had stopped trading by the time the figures were issued. Monday is the Women's Day holiday in Russia.
"Banks were not setting prices expecting U.S. figures," an International Moscow Bank dealer said. "The data were not quite good for the market so prices edged down, but they are pretty firm."
But a possible delay in launching Russia's mark Eurobond due next week was keeping markets nervous, dealer said.
An official at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, joint lead manager of the deal, said on Friday Russia may not launch its Eurobond as expected if sentiment in the emerging market sector does not improve.
